STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a flat white plate with a rim band and a flat centre, no inner wall or bowl shadow. Square-ish flat plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: a square dinner plate is typically 20-30 cm. The plate looks like a medium-large square plate, so I estimate about 25 cm.
b) Reference: the salad leaves and chicken pieces are small. The pizza slice is about 11-12 cm long, and the plate spans roughly two pizza-slice lengths plus the side dish, so the width is about 25-27 cm. Taking the two cues together, width ≈ 25 cm (625 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Pizza (two rectangular slices, stacked, tomato base, cheese, red onion, meat): footprint ≈ 16% of plate = 100 cm². Thickness ≈ 1.5 cm (one slice). Volume 150 ml × 1.0 (mixed bread/cheese/sauce, treated as bulk 0.9) ≈ 135 g. Round to ~150 g including the toppings.
- Mixed salad greens (leaves, carrot, cucumber, olives): footprint ≈ 20% = 125 cm², thickness ~3 cm loose leaves, volume ~375 ml × 0.15 (raw leafy) ≈ 56 g; with the dressing-free chopped veg, use ~60 g.
- Grilled chicken pieces (diced): footprint ≈ 10% = 62 cm², thickness ~1.5 cm → ~94 ml × 1.0 ≈ 95 g.
- Black olives (about 10 visible): 10 × 4 g = 40 g.
- Brown triangular item (dark bread or brownie-like cake with sprinkles, two pieces): about 2 pieces × 30 g = 60 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: The pizza sits on the plate with no base layer beyond the crust; greens are loose and already counted. No extra hidden layer added.

STEP 5 - Energy per 100 g (as served):
- Pizza with cheese and meat: ~260 kcal
- Mixed leafy salad with veg: ~25 kcal
- Grilled chicken: ~165 kcal
- Black olives: ~115 kcal
- Dark bread/cake slice: ~300 kcal

Totals: pizza 150 g (390 kcal), salad 60 g (15 kcal), chicken 95 g (157 kcal), olives 40 g (46 kcal), dark item 60 g (180 kcal). Total ≈ 365 g, ≈ 790 kcal.
